shortBio.en: QOTSA riff architect who pulls Grohl and Jones into Them Crooked Vultures.
shortBio.zh: QOTSA 的 riff 建筑师，把 Grohl 与 Jones 拉进 Them Crooked Vultures。

whyHub.en: QOTSA → Them Crooked Vultures: modern Hard Rock cross-pollination hub.
whyHub.zh: QOTSA → Them Crooked Vultures：当代 Hard Rock 串粉枢纽。

body.en: Homme builds Queens of the Stone Age like a machine shop for riffs, then invites friends over. Them Crooked Vultures is the dinner party that becomes a band—and on our graph it ties Foo Fighters, Zeppelin bloodline, and desert rock into one knot.
body.zh: Homme 把 QOTSA 建成 riff 机修厂，再请客进来。Them Crooked Vultures 是变成乐队的晚宴——在我们图上，它把 Foo Fighters、Zeppelin 血脉与沙漠摇滚打成一个结。
